title: Highly recommend this tour!
text: Fabulous day out with Rebecca! We thoroughly enjoyed our day out. Sightseeing was stunning and her commentary was so informative. Winery was amazing.
author: kathleenkO3331BR

title: Montserrat full day with winery
text: This was the best full day tour of the Montserrat Monastery with lunch at a local restaurant followed by a wonderful experience  at the Pares Balta winery. Our tour guide and driver, Stephen, was fun, knowledgeable and patient . We highly recommend using Explore Catalunya agency as they provided a tour which exceeded our expectations.
author: beagle8212015

title: Great mountain and winery experience
text: It was a great experience in the hand of Nuria our guide who did not hesitate in make our trip an interesting one.
author: Elizabeth_H

title: The perfect day trip for wine, culture, and history!
text: Stephen was awesome and this tour was the perfect mix for us. Montserrat tour with the museum was a great cultural experience. Lunch at a local restaurant was delicious. The family owned winery was very hospitable and Bibi gave us a wonderful overview of their natural wine making process. 10 hours sounds long but it went quickly and was so fun! Highly recommend.
author: X3340BWkathrync

title: Amazing experience!!!
text:

title: AMAZING TOUR WITH AN AWESOME GUIDE!
text: Rod was AMAZING! He was incredibly knowledgeable and kind! He cared about what we wanted to learn while on the tour. He was also very funny and personable.
author: Inspire700988

title: Beautiful views & wine tastings!
text: We had a wonderful experience with Rod our tour guide and David our driver.  The day was amazing filled with memorable moments.  We visited Montserrat with breath taking views.  Then we had lunch in a cozy little restaurant before heading to a wine tasting.  Highly recommend this tour for first time visitors or if this is your second, third time like it was for us!
author: Lina F

title: I definitely would recommend
text: This was the last day of our trip in Spain. It was a long day, but worth it. I would recommend this excursion.  The guide, food and sites were fantastic.  I loved the local town we stopped in for lunch. It wasn’t a “sandwich and chips” lunch.  It was a full 3 course sit down lunch with wine.  The winery was very unique and the tasting was delicious.
author: audreyhX3083GE

title: All day in the Ibérica region
text: Great tour, our driver David and tour guide Rod were both excellent. Could have spent all day in Monserrat, but then we’d have missed the cava tour!
